testName: FK-1304-TC002 Validate that return to service is refused while the category-A defect is only resolved
summary: QA - Vehicle returns to service while its category-A defect is only resolved, in Vehicles
stepsToReproduce: As the driver, report a category-A defect on FK22 DEF
As the transport manager, triage it and raise a job card
As the technician, start work and mark it resolved
As the transport manager, return FK22 DEF to service
actualResult: FK22 DEF is back in service. The vehicle is Roadworthy although its category-A defect is Resolved, not Closed.
expectedResult: FK22 DEF can't return to service: category-A defect <ID> is not closed. The vehicle stays VOR.
evidence: Reproduced twice. The page shows the success message; the test's assertion and the plan's Expected Result agree (BR-019), so this is not a test-side cause.
